mostWorthwhile.text: Reusing iron to make new red blood cells was most worthwhile: it connected recycling old cells to making their oxygen-carrying protein.

leastWorthwhile.text: Growing skin cells was straightforward and the only available combination at that point, so it involved less of a decision.

surprise.text: I found it interesting that the marrow stays intact while new red cells enter the blood with reused iron.

arbitrary.text: Nothing felt arbitrary; both routes had a clear purpose from the goals and pictures.

continue.text: I would probably continue: the iron-recycling route made a familiar body process feel connected, though I would hope for more meaningful choices.
